description: This file defines tracing mode switches and related functions for PyTorch's JIT tracer, including API controls and guard structures for enabling/disabling tracing features.

classes.name: NoTracerDispatchMode
classes.description: Guard class that temporarily disables tracer dispatch key within its scope.

methods.name: is_dispatch_enabled
methods.description: Checks if tracer dispatch is enabled based on thread-local dispatch key state.

methods.name: set_dispatch_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables tracer dispatch key in thread-local storage.
